comment: Patch set for ONE exact stock build. Fill in the TODO values from YOUR OWN unit.
Nothing here is an Akai binary - only the offsets and the bytes YOU change.
Patches are applied in place: 'patched' must be the same length as 'original'
(no inserting/removing bytes, so nothing shifts). Use a code-cave or an
LD_PRELOAD .so if you need more room than a patch site gives you.

result.comment: Optional. If set, the applier refuses to finish unless the fully-patched binary matches this. Fill it in once you have a known-good patched build.

patches.description: EXAMPLE ONLY - delete this and add your real changes. Writes a single AArch64 NOP.
